results.title: Centre & Assam Capable Of Managing Floods, No Foreign Aid Required: CM Sarma
results.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said the state and Central governments are capable of handling flood relief and do not require international assistance. As rescue operations wind down, the focus has shifted to rehabilitation, including house repairs, medical camps, compensation, education support and financial relief. Floods have affected nearly 11 lakh people across 2,101 villages.

32k-Mile 2009 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet 6-Speed
results.description: This 2009 Porsche 911 Turbo cabriolet is finished in Carrara White over Cocoa Special leather and features body-color-painted 19" Turbo wheels, interior trim, and side skirts. The convertible has accumulated 32k miles and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.6L flat-six that drives all four wheels via a six-speed manual transaxle. Capped with a Cocoa soft top, the car also features an aftermarket exhaust system, the Sport Chrono Package, heated front Sport seats, a Bose sound system, and PCM with navigation. Recently acquired by the selling dealer, a BaT Local Partner , this 997.1 Turbo cabriolet is now offered with a build list, a clean Carfax report, and a clean New Jersey title.
